description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Architecting the sub-millisecond decision engine that powers 200 million daily ad interactions

The Demand Core team and backend platform squads build the foundational infrastructure that determines which of our thousands of active advertising campaigns are relevant to a user the moment they open Playtime. At our scale, system latency is a business failure: downtime means advertisers stop spending, users stop earning rewards, and publisher revenue stalls. As a Staff Backend Developer, you will own the architectural integrity, reliability, and long-term evolution of the distributed systems that power these decisions 200 million times every day across multiple teams.
Go microservices load the active ad campaign catalog into memory, evaluating 40+ targeting constraints and 30+ real-time signals like geo, fraud status, budget caps, to rank potential user performance in milliseconds. About Letly
Letly is the AI-Native operating company built for the home. We believe the home should be autonomously run and we're building the software that will run all rental properties end-to-end.
Our landlords hand us their most valuable asset, often on a guaranteed rent, so how well a property is run is our product. Property Managers own every property after the tenant moves in: compliance, maintenance, rent, renewals and the relationship with the landlord and tenant.
We've raised a $4m pre-seed and are a small, high-agency team, growing revenue at >100% month-over-month. We're hiring to keep service quality ahead of that growth.

How we manage
We run portfolios, not inboxes. Every property has an owner who knows its compliance dates, its contractors, its rent position and its tenant by name. Problems get fixed before the landlord or tenant has to chase.
We're honest about what's ours to fix and what isn't. Repairs are triaged on liability and urgency, quoted against evidence and closed out with proof. AI handles the triage, chasing and admin, so a PM's time goes on decisions, contractors and people.
When a guaranteed property sits empty or arrears build, it's our money on the line, so a PM thinks like an owner.

What we're looking for
Experience. ~2+ years running a residential lettings portfolio as a property manager, at an agency, BTR operator or block manager.

Working knowledge of landlord compliance: gas safety, EICR, EPC, smoke and CO alarms, deposit protection,…

⚖️ Who are we
Plato is building the AI OS for litigation lawyers.
With AI, the legal industry is on the verge of a major transformation. Litigation lawyers are overwhelmed by complex and repetitive tasks: complex damage calculations, thousands of documents to review, days spent drafting legal documents, and more.

Our mission: Build the leading AI OS for litigation lawyers, enabling professionals to work 5x faster, by putting their whole firm on autopilot.

Plato already supports more than 30 law firms and 1 major insurance company’s legal team, who use our solution daily to manage hundreds of active cases.
Founded in January 2026 by Ben (CEO) and Alexandre (CTO), we are backed by Hexa (formerly eFounders), Europe’s leading startup studio. Hexa has launched over 35 companies, including unicorns such as Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, collectively generating more than €230M in ARR and raising over €750M in funding.
Plato is live with real users, real data and real revenue, solving concrete legal workflows in production. We’re now looking for a Founding AI Engineer to help us turn the latest advances in AI into reliable products used every day by legal professionals.

🎯 Your mission
You’ll work directly with Alexandre , our CTO, at the intersection of AI, software engineering and product.
Your job is not to do AI research for the sake of research. You’ll experiment with models and approaches, understand what works, and turn the best solutions into reliable production…

E-Finances est un éditeur de logiciels B2B spécialisé dans la gestion financière et la trésorerie. Nos solutions aident les entreprises à optimiser leurs flux financiers et à gagner en visibilité sur leur trésorerie. At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry.

We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast.

This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company.

Wanna join the adventure?

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the hub processor, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit.

The Deployment & Runtime Environments team is where software meets the satellite. description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 

Position Description

We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine.

Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing…

Over 12Build
12Build is een SaaS-platform dat bouwbedrijven met elkaar verbindt en zo de samenwerking in de bouw makkelijker en transparanter maakt. We bestaan bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds hard. We geven je geen dichtgetimmerde opdracht. Je gaat samen met Ed, je begeleider vanuit 12Build, uitzoeken welke uitdaging het beste past bij jouw opleiding en interesses. Het eindresultaat ligt wel vast: je levert een innovatief product op dat 12Build echt kan gebruiken. Dat kan een concept zijn, een tool, een strategie, een prototype of een nieuw proces, zolang het werkt en waarde oplevert.

Ontwerpvraag (startpunt):
Welk innovatief product kan 12Build ontwikkelen om sneller en slimmer te groeien in de internationale markt, en hoe ziet dat product eruit Samen maak je deze vraag in de eerste weken concreet. Mogelijke richtingen:

We’re looking for US-based, actively practicing physicians (MD/DO) to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation program. General and internal medicine are our main focus. While each project involves unique tasks, contributors may:

Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;

Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;

Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;

Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

To solve the world's most pressing problems, we need tomorrow's problem-solvers equipped with Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math (STEM) knowledge, skills, and inspiration. We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. Veiligheidsregio Kennemerland (VRK) zet zich met ongeveer 1.400 medewerkers in voor de veiligheid en gezondheid van negen gemeenten. Onder de VRK vallen onder meer de Brandweer, de GGD, Ambulancezorg, Veilig Thuis, Crisisbeheersing en de Meldkamer Noord-Holland.

description:
De opdracht 
Van veranderkundig advies naar daadwerkelijke verandering. Daar ligt jouw opdracht. Voor twee veranderopgaven binnen het sociaal domein van de gemeente Den Haag zoeken we een ervaren senior implementatiemanager die veranderkundige expertise combineert met implementatiekracht. Ben jij een ervaren implementatiemanager die beweging weet te creëren in complexe maatschappelijke opgaven? Kun jij veranderkundige inzichten verbinden aan concrete resultaten en beschik je over de kracht om veranderingen daadwerkelijk te laten landen in de praktijk? Breng jij structuur en voortgang, zie je patronen en heb je oog voor belangen, krijg je mensen in beweging en kun je tegelijkertijd het eigenaarschap van de lijn versterken? Dan ben jij de senior implementatiemanager die we zoeken voor de ondersteuning van de teams Wet Maatschappelijke Ondersteuning (Wmo) en Jeugdgezondheidszorg (JGZ) binnen het Sociaal Domein. Er liggen twee uitdagende opdrachten waarbij organisatieontwikkeling, cultuurverandering en implementatie hand in hand gaan, daarnaast ben jij ook in de lead voor een pilot passend bij de twee opdrachten.

Wat ga je doen?
Als Senior Implementatiemanager begeleid je complexe verandertrajecten van ontwerp naar uitvoering. Je brengt structuur, regie en voortgang aan in trajecten waarin al denkwerk is verricht, maar waar de daadwerkelijke implementatie en borging nog vorm moet krijgen.

Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App (web and mobile), we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.
Design is central to this vision. Our users are care professionals working with clients, not behind a desk. Every flow we build needs to be simple, fast and safe to use. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines.

As a Hardware Test Engineer at Optics11, you play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our fiber-optic sensing systems. You develop and execute hardware tests at board and sub-system level, identifying potential issues early and helping our engineers deliver robust, production-ready solutions.

Combining hands-on hardware engineering with test automation, you build test setups, analyze results, support prototype development, and help transfer testing processes from R&D to production.
You will be part of our Sensing Platform Team, working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, production, and external partners.

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Everyone at Airbnb thinks about trust, but our team obsesses over it daily. At the core of trust is safety, and thus we spend a significant amount of our time and energy keeping the community safe. The Trust team is responsible for developing the technology that helps protect our community and platform from fraud while also ensuring our hosts, guests, homes, and experiences meet our high standards. We constantly work to fight against online fraud (such as monetary loss, compromised accounts, spam and scam in messages, fake inventory, etc.) as well as offline fraud (theft, property damage, personal safety, etc.). We also work on onboarding and screening of users, and think about complex topics like identity and reputation to ensure that every interaction with Airbnb helps build trust in us and our community.

You'll work side-by-side with talented product managers, data scientists, software engineers, fraud intelligence, and operations teams. Together, you'll design and build ML solutions that have direct, meaningful impact on user trust, business success, and the global Airbnb…

description:
AI Trainer - Video Annotation
Remote   |   Independent Contractor   

Prove your skills. Get certified. 
Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. 

▌ What you will do
As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to:
Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events.

Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines.

Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements.

Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues.

▌ What you bring
Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.

Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently.

A commitment to accuracy and consistency.

No previous AI or robotics experience required.

▌ What the work looks like
You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible.

Please note:  We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Abuse Research Group (ARG) handles proactive threat hunting and adversary behavior analysis across Stripe products. Rather than reacting to alerts, the team maps end-to-end fraud and abuse paths, validates novel attack vectors, and identifies product conditions that enable fraud. Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge —you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge—you will often be "the PM."

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

The Platform pillar builds the internal machinery that powers these surfaces, and is responsible for making our websites fast, stable, and easy to update.

Together we design and build stripe.com and other sites that amount to what is, for many, their first impression of Stripe. description:
Who we are

About Bridge

Bridge is building a new payments platform powered by stablecoins to make global money movement simpler, faster, and more accessible. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders, give customers access to dollars through virtual accounts, and disburse USD globally.

We believe stablecoin rails will become a foundational part of financial infrastructure, moving and settling trillions of dollars worldwide. Bridge is helping bring that future forward.

Our team has built financial infrastructure at companies including Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, and Airbnb. We are united by the conviction that stablecoins can materially improve how money moves around the world.

What you’ll do

Build and ship end-to-end product experiences across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and data systems.

Design reliable, performant, and intuitive interfaces for developers, operations teams, and end users interacting with Bridge products.

Develop and maintain the APIs and backend systems that power global payments, virtual accounts, and payouts.

Own projects from technical design through launch and iteration, often operating with substantial autonomy and without dedicated product management support.

Debug and resolve production issues across the stack, with a focus on reliability, performance, and customer impact.

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Governments around the world are fundamentally changing how businesses report and exchange transactions. Continuous Transaction Controls (CTC) and e-invoicing mandates — now active or imminent in France, Germany, Spain, Poland, and across Latin America — require businesses to transmit structured invoice data through certified government networks in real time. For Stripe's global user base, compliant e-invoicing is rapidly becoming a prerequisite for conducting commerce, not a nice-to-have.

We're building the e-invoicing infrastructure that makes this invisible for Stripe users. That means embedding compliant invoice generation, validation, and transmission directly into Stripe Billing and Invoicing — abstracting the full complexity of regional mandates and network certification behind a seamless product experience.

About the team 

Collecting and filing sales & indirect taxes is a classic area for technology disruption. Companies selling across countries, states, and even smaller jurisdictions have to navigate through a myriad of tax rates, product-level tax exemptions, filing requirements, and registration obligations. The rules are constantly changing, and not accurately calculating and filing tax can have legal ramifications.

It’s no surprise then that solving for tax compliance is a top user ask. We launched Stripe Tax as a new SaaS product in 2021 to help solve this pain point and make tax compliance as effortless as possible. About the team 

Collecting and filing sales & indirect taxes is a classic area for technology disruption. Companies selling across countries, states, and even smaller jurisdictions have to navigate through a myriad of tax rates, product-level tax exemptions, filing requirements, and registration obligations. The rules are constantly changing, and not accurately calculating and filing tax can have legal ramifications.

It’s no surprise then that solving for tax compliance is a top user ask. We launched Stripe Tax as a new SaaS product in 2021 to help solve this pain point and make tax compliance as effortless as possible. The Stripe Tax Capabilities team engineers sophisticated solutions for our largest merchants, who face unique and highly complex tax requirements that differ significantly from smaller businesses, by automating their most intricate global compliance use cases.
